name: Evil Parrot 25
author: alexruix
description: White search input that reacts on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, outline becomes 1px solid #d3d3d3. On focus, border-bottom becomes 2px solid #5b5fc7, border-radius becomes 4px 4px 2px 2px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Evil Parrot 25</title>
<style>
/* Evil Parrot 25 by alexruix — https://uiverse.io/alexruix/evil-parrot-25 */
.input {
  max-width: 190px;
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
  color: #242424;
  padding: .15rem .5rem;
  min-height: 40px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  outline: none;
  border: none;
  line-height: 1.15;
  box-shadow: 0px 10px 20px -18px;
}

input:focus {
  border-bottom: 2px solid #5b5fc7;
  border-radius: 4px 4px 2px 2px;
}

input:hover {
  outline: 1px solid lightgrey;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input class="input" name="text" placeholder="Search..." type="search">

</body>
</html>
